This release fixes the Windows startup crash that said it could not find `.config\Vencord\dist\patcher.js`.

What changed

- The installer now uses the right configuration folder on Windows, even when HOME is not set.
- It checks the patcher path before changing Discord, so a missing build cannot leave Discord pointing at a file that does not exist.
- Failed or incomplete downloads leave your current build in place and show an error instead of reporting success.
- Installer updates and the PowerShell download script now stay on this fork.
- Existing Vencord settings and the Windows installer filenames are kept for compatibility.

If you hit the startup error, close Discord, run the new installer, and choose Repair for the affected Discord version. Then reopen Discord.

Downloads

- Windows: VencordInstaller.exe is the graphical installer. VencordInstallerCli.exe is the command-line version.
- Linux: VencordInstallerCli-linux is the x86-64 command-line installer.
- macOS: VencordInstallerCli-darwin is the universal command-line installer for Intel and Apple Silicon. A macOS graphical installer is not included in this release.
- SHA256SUMS contains the checksums for the installer downloads.

Based on Vencord Installer, with the original license and contributor credits preserved.
